title: Quietly Aged Tuscan Korean Pear Ribollita
description: A fermented and aerated Italian dish featuring Korean pear and shio-koji cure, served in a traditional Tuscan ribollita style. This raw-friendly meal is perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the diced Korean pear and shio-koji mixture, letting it ferment at room temperature for 24 hours.
After fermentation, heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cannellini beans, vegetable broth, and fermented pear mixture to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped kale and cook until wilted.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup to the desired consistency.
Serve the ribollita hot, garnished with additional kale if desired.
